in_sanskrit.name: निर्वाण
in_sanskrit.meaning: Freedom from suffering, liberation, or release from the cycle of rebirth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The state of being free from all pain, sorrow, and suffering. It is a state of perfect peace, happiness, and enlightenment. Nirvana is the ultimate goal of many spiritual and philosophical traditions, including Buddhism.

in_hindi.name: Nirav
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Free from sorrow
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nirav एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nirām’ which means ‘free from sorrow, misery, and pain’. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the God of Rain and Thunder, who is believed to bestow happiness and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: Nirav
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Free from sorrow
in_tamil.long_meaning: Nirav ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nirām’ which means ‘free from sorrow, misery, and pain’. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the God of Rain and Thunder, who is believed to bestow happiness and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: Nirav
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Free from sorrow
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nirav ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nirām’ which means ‘free from sorrow, misery, and pain’. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the God of Rain and Thunder, who is believed to bestow happiness and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Nirav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Free from sorrow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nirām’ which means ‘free from sorrow, misery, and pain’. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the God of Rain and Thunder, who is believed to bestow happiness and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Nirav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Free from sorrow
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nirav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nirām’ which means ‘free from sorrow, misery, and pain’. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the God of Rain and Thunder, who is believed to bestow happiness and prosperity.
